"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reduce barriers for working families to benefit from targeted tax breaks, including the Earned Income Tax Credit and the Child Tax Credit.",

"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"More generous, refundable tax credits will benefit low- and middle-income families.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Financial institutions should never be \"too big to fail.\"",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to reverse the over-financialization of the American economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will curb Wall Street speculation by maintaining and expanding safeguards that separate retail banking institutions from more risky investment operations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Wall Street investors will pay their fair share in taxes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Obama-Biden Administration's Dodd-Frank financial reform law will be strengthened and enforced, including the Volcker Rule, to protect American workers from future financial crises.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"An updated and modernized version of Glass-Steagall will be supported.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Criminal penalties will be backed for reckless executives who illegally gamble with the savings and economic security of their clients and American communities when justified by the law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
